why: CPCA article 519 reserves the special provisions on the publication of claims to rescind, annul, amend or undo rights based on published deeds; from memory these are in Decree 76-63 on the land register, article 85. A rule on which claims must be published before they are admissible would cite it (open point o2).
Ordinance 75-74 on the general land survey and the land register: effect of publication of real rights (from memory article 15 and 16), to read around the duty to publish a real-property petition.
Publication as the condition of the transfer of real rights (from memory), to tell the publication of deeds apart from the publication of a petition.
Pre-emption procedure (from memory articles 799 to 803): whether the pre-emption claim or declaration must be published at the land registry; the store's civil code stops at article 570.
